name: dca-core
description: The Domain-Centric Architecture method as skills, for Java/Spring and .NET/C#: dca-describe writes the project description (product, technical decisions, designed domain) under project/; dca-new starts a project from a generator and lays out contexts, use cases, aggregates, stores and domain services; dca-init adds the published dca-building-blocks/dca-archunit or DomainCentric.BuildingBlocks/ArchRules packages, one architecture test and the method's section in AGENTS.md; dca-add brings in one capability (rule module, freeze, formatter, browser runner); dca-modelling carries the tactical-modelling craft, dca-discipline the invariants, dca-review the DCA conformance review, dca-knowledge the cited knowledge catalog. Pairs with dca-craft.
